headline: Heavy cream, massaged in until absorbed
caption: Marula Oil 5% Face Moisturizer is a heavy cream, suitable for dry to normal skin types. Use after cleansing, toning and applying all serums; massage into face and neck until it is fully absorbed, AM & PM. The person image is AI-generated and illustrative.
